text:
Are you tired of applying to jobs?

I built a @bot that applies to hundreds of relevant jobs for you every day, customises your CV for each role without making up things and puts your job search on autopilot.

Test it here https://x.ai/bot/gfxH6sM_0QlxeDNFrRmep

Thank @elonmusk and the @grok team for your next job.
